name: jetbrain-search-everywhere
description: Fast and customizable files, symbols search engine. An alternative for 'Go to symbol in workspace' built-in feature.

searchEverywhere.shouldInitOnStartup.description: Should indexing be initialized on Visual Studio Code startup.

searchEverywhere.shouldDisplayNotificati.description: Should display indexing notification in toast or status bar.

searchEverywhere.shouldHighlightSymbol.description: Should the selected symbol be highlighted.

searchEverywhere.shouldUseDebounce.description: Should the debounce function be used while returning filter results (useful in case of the large workspace).

searchEverywhere.icons.description: Ability to define icons that should be displayed for appropriate item types. According to VSC API, only Octicons are allowed. Not defined item type will not have any icon.

searchEverywhere.itemsFilter.description: Ability to define a filter that should be applied to items.

searchEverywhere.excludeProperties.description: Exclude object properties (kind 6) to reduce index size by more than 50% and eliminate property noise in large codebases.

searchEverywhere.excludeVariables.description: Exclude variables and constants (kind 12). Disabled by default so newly written variables and constants are indexed.

searchEverywhere.shouldUseItemsFilterPhr.description: Should be a possibility to filter by assigned filter phrases.

searchEverywhere.itemsFilterPhrases.description: One-kind filter phrases, keyed by symbol kind, e.g. { "11": "ff " }. A phrase that is also used by a category belongs to the category.

icon.description: Codicon id shown on the category's button, for example symbol-class. Defaults to filter.

searchEverywhere.categories.description: Named groups of symbol kinds. Type a category's phrase at the start of the query, press Tab / Shift+Tab, or click a category button to search only those kinds.

searchEverywhere.helpPhrase.description: A phrase that should invoke help.

searchEverywhere.shouldItemsBeSorted.description: Ability to decide whether items should be grouped and sorted by type. When false (recommended), items are ranked strictly by relevance.

searchEverywhere.shouldSearchSelection.description: Ability to decide whether selection in the active editor is put in the search.

searchEverywhere.previewOnSelect.description: Open the highlighted item in a preview editor, without moving focus, as the selection moves in the search. Escape returns to the editor that was active before the search opened.

searchEverywhere.restoreLastQuery.description: Put the last workspace query back, selected, when the search is opened again. Typing replaces it. A non-empty editor selection still wins when shouldSearchSelection is on.

searchEverywhere.handOffPrefixes.description: A query typed with > as its first character opens the VS Code command palette, and one starting with % opens VS Code's text search, with the rest of the query. A category or filter phrase starting with the same character still wins.

searchEverywhere.exclude.description: An array of globs. Any file matching these globs will be excluded from indexing.

searchEverywhere.include.description: String with include pattern. Any file matching this glob will be included in indexing.

searchEverywhere.indexNamesOnly.description: Glob, matched against the workspace-relative path, of included files that are indexed by file name only. Their symbols are never requested from a language server. An empty string asks for symbols of every included file.

searchEverywhere.secondaryCode.description: Globs, matched against the workspace-relative path, of test, mock and generated files. Their items stay searchable but rank after other items of the same match quality and are tagged `· test` or `· generated`. Changing it does not reindex.

enumDescriptions: Detect Go (go.mod, go.work) and Java (pom.xml, build.gradle, build.gradle.kts, settings.gradle) at each workspace folder root and fill include, exclude and itemsFilter.ignoredKinds you have not set yourself.
Use the contributed defaults for include, exclude and itemsFilter.
searchEverywhere.languagePresets.description: Fill include, exclude and itemsFilter with values suited to the Go or Java project found at a workspace folder root, wherever you have not set them at any level.

searchEverywhere.excludeMode.description: Ability to choose which exclude option should be applied. If gitignore file is not found or is empty, the extension option is used as a fallback. To see the changes from the updated gitignore file after indexing, the reload must be done.

searchEverywhere.shouldWorkspaceDataBeCa.description: Ability to decide if the workspace should be indexed only once. Each next startup of Visual Studio Code will collect data from cache.

searchEverywhere.shareCacheAcrossWorktre.description: Share and seed indexed database cache across git worktrees and clones of the same repository for near-instant startup.

searchEverywhere.watchFileSystem.description: Watch the file system and update the index when files are created, changed or deleted outside VS Code, for example by git, a code generator or a terminal command.

searchEverywhere.searchLanguageServersWh.description: While the index is being built, also ask the language servers for symbols matching the query and show the ones not indexed yet under Not indexed yet. The Include libraries toggle works regardless.

searchEverywhere.showRecentItemsOnEmptyQ.description: Show recent items and open files when search input is empty.

searchEverywhere.recentItemsLimit.description: Maximum number of recent items to show when search input is empty.

searchEverywhere.rankRecentItemsHigher.description: Show recently opened files and symbols first among equally good matches while typing.

searchEverywhere.useFileIconTheme.description: Show file icons from the active VS Code file icon theme (e.g. Seti, Material Icon Theme) instead of the built-in icon. Requires VS Code 1.108 or newer; older versions keep the built-in icon.
